archived_prestrain_field_check.interpretation: The first archived XPLT fiber-stretch field is explained by a uniform scalar generator plus spatial deformation. This scalar field cannot by itself prove or disprove a full-tensor prestrain correction. The prior claim that spatial variation proved an unimplemented elementwise history was false and is withdrawn. Later increments and FEBio 2.9.1 correction semantics still require verification.

corrected_fiber_frame_probe.cause: The source ligament vector was passed as an energy parameter after the same source vector had already defined the FEM material frame. The energy therefore used a twice-rotated fiber direction.
corrected_fiber_frame_probe.correction: Pass local unit +X as the energy fiber parameter when an authored element material frame maps local +X to the source vector.

stress_comparison.method: Capture full Matter first-Newton element forces at the imported XPLT configuration, reconstruct Cauchy stress using immutable source tet4 geometry and the current deformation, compare with archived XPLT stress in xx yy zz xy yz xz order.

full_tissue_precision_probe.method: Hash-bound first-assembly element forces from the complete coupled knee are converted to Cauchy stress and compared to all twelve archived XPLT tissue domains at state 1. For MCL/LCL the pinned source constitutive law is also evaluated with original double coordinates and with the same float32 metre coordinate rounding used by Matter.
full_tissue_precision_probe.interpretation: The source law reproduces the archived MCL/LCL stresses with double coordinates. Rounding reference and current absolute positions to float32 metres reproduces almost the entire Matter discrepancy. Precision of FEM deformation input must be repaired within the coupled state before source-equivalent preload acceptance; extra Newton iterations cannot remove this stress error. These are imported-pose diagnostics, not an accepted Matter state.
